title: Cache-aside helper: past-TTL read miss triggers a second origin call
asA: developer relying on cache-aside for staleness bounds
iWant: the cache-aside helper to re-invoke origin after the elicited TTL elapses
soThat: the applied project observes a bounded staleness ceiling that matches the elicited TTL

acceptanceCriteria.description: After the TTL elapses (in-memory driver clock advances past the expiration), cache-aside.getOr(key, originFn) finds nothing and invokes originFn a second time. The invocation counter reaches 2 and the returned value comes from origin.
acceptanceCriteria.when: getOr(key, originFn) runs after clock advance past TTL
acceptanceCriteria.then: the invocation counter reaches 2; the returned value comes from origin
